purpose: Three clean repeated full-stack pilots before the canonical 60-cell campaign.
notes: Rates are computed over the common steady-state interval after detector startup and before terminal shutdown.
RTF is simulation-time span divided by wall-time span using detector image receive wall clocks.
The minimum detector/manager/belief qualification rate is 3 Hz; the commissioned target remains 5 Hz.
Any failed repetition blocks the 60-cell campaign; thresholds are not changed after observing pilots.
